# Ignore initial tag subscription
    if initialChange:
        return

    # Detect leading edge: False -> True
    if currentValue.value == True and previousValue.value == False:
        
        # Read machine, operation and product code
        machine = system.tag.readBlocking([
            "[default]Sub Assembly Lasers v1/Laser 2 (East)/Op140/Machine"
        ])[0].value

        operation = system.tag.readBlocking([
            "[default]Sub Assembly Lasers v1/Laser 2 (East)/Op140/Operation"
        ])[0].value

        product_code = system.tag.readBlocking([
            "[default]Sub Assembly Lasers v1/Laser 2 (East)/Op140/ProductCode"
        ])[0].value
        
        feed = "outfeed"

        # Named Query parameters
        params = {
            "datetime_input": system.date.now(),
            "machine": machine,
            "operation": operation,
            "product_code": product_code,
            "feed": feed
        }

        # Execute Named Query
        system.db.runNamedQuery(
        	 "sub-assembly-production-performance",
            "Sub Assembly Production/SubAssemblyProductionFeeds",
            params
        )

        system.util.getLogger("SubAssemblyProductionRecords").info(
            "%s recorded. machine: %s, operation: %s"
            % (feed, machine, operation)
        )

logger = system.util.getLogger("SubAssemblyFaultTracking")
	
	# Value Changed Event on MachineState tag
	if initialChange:
	    return
	
	oldState = previousValue.value
	newState = currentValue.value
	
	# Tag paths
	machineTagPath = "[default]Sub Assembly Lasers v1/Laser 2 (East)/Op110/Machine"
	faultMessageTagPath = "[default]Sub Assembly Lasers v1/Laser 2 (East)/Op110/FaultCode"
	
	# Entering fault state
	if oldState != 5 and newState == 5:
	
	    machine = system.tag.readBlocking([machineTagPath])[0].value
	    faultMessage = system.tag.readBlocking([faultMessageTagPath])[0].value
	    startTime = system.date.now()
	
	    params = {
	        "machine": machine,
	        "faultMessage": faultMessage,
	        "startTime": startTime
	    }
	
	    system.db.runNamedQuery(
	    	"sub-assembly-production-performance",
	    	"Sub Assembly Production/SubAssemblyFaultInsert",
	    	params
	    )
	    
	    logger.info(
	    		"fault entry | Machine=%s | Fault=%s | StartTime=%s"
	    		% (machine, faultMessage, startTime)
	    )
	
	# Updating/exiting fault state
	elif oldState == 5 and newState != 5:
	
	    machine = system.tag.readBlocking([machineTagPath])[0].value
	
	    params = {
	        "machine": machine,
	        "endTime": system.date.now()
	    }
	
	    system.db.runNamedQuery(
	    	"sub-assembly-production-performance",
	    	"Sub Assembly Production/SubAssemblyFaultComplete",
	    	params
	    )
	    
	    logger.info(
	    		"fault closed | Machine=%s | StartTime=%s"
	    		% (machine, startTime)
	    )
